non_event_control: same-weekday non-EIA sessions, evaluated at the same clock windows
surprise_definition: actual_bcf-consensus_bcf, using the contemporaneous unrevised consensus

natural_rules_only.pre_announcement: unconditional position over the frozen morning window; direction reported both ways before any promotion decision
natural_rules_only.post_announcement_continuation: direction equals sign of the completed initial reaction; enter on the next tradable bar
natural_rules_only.post_announcement_reversal: direction is opposite sign of the completed initial reaction; enter on the next tradable bar

causality.signal_bar_execution: never execute at the close used to form the signal; use the next bar open
causality.roll_information: point-in-time volume-ranked continuous mapping or explicit contract roll rule

statistics.sharpe_annualization: sqrt(52) for one trade per weekly event; otherwise use observed annual opportunity rate
statistics.subperiods: chronological halves and calendar-era table when each cell has at least 30 events
